name: com.amplifyframework.pushnotifications.pinpoint.AWSPinpointPushNotificationsActivity
description: AWS Amplify's Pinpoint push plugin opens this Activity when a user taps a push notification; it records the open event and follows the notification URL or deep link, falling back to the app's launch screen.
disableEffect: Tapping these push notifications will no longer open their linked screen; other app features remain available.
